access_links.label: KiwiRail Electrified Network (WFS)
access_links.note: Alternate-format item metadata agrees on publisher and resource scope. Distribution content was not downloaded or compared.

access_note: Public metadata was readable without authentication. Data queries, download access and service operation were not tested. The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats.
description: KiwiRail publishes polylines showing the extent of electrified railway in New Zealand. The source warns that the lines may not follow the exact track centreline. The service supplies location and reference fields in New Zealand Transverse Mercator. Feature-service and WFS listings describe the same resource, although the WFS description also uses the word shapefile. The record represents electrification extent, not traction-power capacity, voltage or operational status. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service and alternate item listings. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
